#021 · Tiny Bird Pokémon

Spearow

Normal Flying

Kanto · Generation 1

Spearow is a Normal/Flying-type Tiny Bird Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 0.3 m tall and weighs 2 kg. It evolves into Fearow. Its highest base stat is Speed (70), with a base stat total of 262.
